I am young but I have been helping my mother in the garden since I was small. This plot is only a small piece, and beans do not need so much fertilizer like maize because they bring their own goodness to the soil. I do not have money for chemical fertilizer on the legumes — I will save the little I have for the maize plot. I will put some manure from our goats, use the seeds I kept from last harvest, and weed by hand with my sisters. Rain will water the plot; we have no pump here in Zomba for such a small garden.
